AdministrativeArea.description: One district (okres) or municipality (obec) of the region, its outline and its code.

areaCode.description: The area's statistical code: LAU 1 (`SK0321`) for a district, LAU 2 (`SK0321508438`) for a municipality, the same codes the Statistical Office's cubes carry in `refArea`.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

divisionLevel.description: Which tier of the territorial division the area is.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

refParentArea.description: The district a municipality lies in; absent on a district.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

surfaceArea.description: The area's surface as the cadastre states it.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

AdministrativeArea.title: AdministrativeArea

Bridge.description: One bridge of the road network in the region, its road, its age, its size and who manages it.

bridgeCode.description: The bridge's number in the national road databank (Cestná databanka), such as `M9673`.

bridgedLength.description: The length of the bridged gap.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

districtName.description: The district the record lies in, by name, as the publisher writes it.

heritageStatus.description: Whether the bridge is a listed monument; absent where the databank does not say.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

managerName.description: The road administration that manages the bridge.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

roadClass.description: The class of the road the bridge carries.

roadNumber.description: The number of the road the bridge carries, such as `66b`.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

spanCount.description: How many openings the bridge has.

structureKind.description: The kind of load-bearing structure, in the databank's words, such as `dosková`.

structureMaterial.description: The material of the load-bearing structure, in the databank's words.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

yearBuilt.description: The year the bridge was built.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

x-enum-descriptions.cultural: The bridge is a listed cultural monument.
x-enum-descriptions.culturalAndTechnical: The bridge is listed as a cultural and a technical monument.
x-enum-descriptions.notListed: The bridge is not a listed monument.

x-enum-descriptions.culture: A theatre, a museum, a gallery, a library or an education centre (kultúra).
x-enum-descriptions.office: An office or an agency of the region (úrad).
x-enum-descriptions.school: A secondary school or a school facility (školy).

PointOfInterest.description: One hospital (by its facility number in the health-care register) or one registered social service a municipality, a town or the region provides; `category` says which. The FIWARE Smart Data Model PointOfInterest (T-4329): no published model is a hospital or a social service. Private providers of social services are not in the space.

address.description: The postal address as the register publishes it, field by field (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress, T-4329); a field the register leaves out is absent, never guessed.

capacity.description: How many people the service may take at once, as registered; absent for a service registered without one.

category.description: What kind of place it is: `hospital` or `socialService`. The two registers share the Smart Data Model PointOfInterest, and an application asks for one with `q=category=="hospital"` (T-4329).

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

districtName.description: The district the record lies in, by name, as the publisher writes it.

hospitalKind.description: Whether the hospital is a general one or specialises in some fields.

legalId.description: The body's identification number (IČO) in the Slovak register of legal persons.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

medicalSpecialties.description: The fields of medicine the hospital is licensed for, with their codes, as the register lists them.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

operatorName.description: The legal person that runs it, as the register names it.

providerKind.description: Which public body provides the service.

serviceForm.description: How the service reaches the person it serves.

serviceKind.description: The kind of social service in the words of Act 448/2008 Z. z., such as `zariadenie pre seniorov` or `opatrovateľská služba`.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

targetGroup.description: Whom the service is for, as the provisions of the Act the register cites.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

url.description: The web page the publisher gives for it.

PointOfInterest.title: PointOfInterest

PostalAddress.description: The value of `address`: a postal address, never an entity of its own (Smart Data Models' common schema).

addressCountry.description: The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

streetAddress.description: The street and the house number, or the venue.

address.description: The postal address as the register publishes it, field by field (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress, T-4329); a field the register leaves out is absent, never guessed.

alternateName.description: The shorter name the organisation goes by, when it differs from the official one.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

legalId.description: The body's identification number (IČO) in the Slovak register of legal persons.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

organizationCategory.description: The field the region founded the organisation for.

preferredLabel.description: The organisation's official name, as CPSV-AP's PublicOrganization requires it.

refMunicipality.description: The municipality the record lies in.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

spatial.description: The municipality the organisation is in, by name, as CPSV-AP's PublicOrganization requires it.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.
